summary: Tested (a) Demo Invite template trial-days follow Plan Catalog (30 days, not 7), (b) new Founder's personal invitation template (super-admin can send, HTML preview, 6 MONTHS COMPLETELY FREE, contact details), (c) founder signup grants 180-day trial + signup_offer=founder_6m, (d) WhatsApp Invite Recently-invited table with per-row delete + Clear all. Backend: 11/11 passed. Frontend: DemoCampaign card toggles, previews, and WA invite table with headers Type/Phone/Business/City/Invited on/By, per-row delete + clear-all all confirmed. One landing-page regression: hero still says '7-Day Free Trial' instead of '30-Day'.

minor.issue: Response key is 'campaigns' (not 'items') and stores campaign-level rows even when Resend refuses (sent_count=0). This is fine but should be documented so the UI 'Recent Campaigns' does not present failed sends as successes.

ui_bugs.issue: Hero pill still hardcoded as '7-DAY FREE TRIAL · No credit card' and CTA subtext '2-minute signup, 7-day free trial' — inconsistent with Plan Catalog trial_days=30 and with the updated Demo Campaign email. User's original request #1 asks for trial-days to follow config everywhere.

action_items: Landing.jsx: replace hardcoded '7-Day Free Trial' hero pill AND '2-minute signup, 7-day free trial' CTA subtext with the trial_days coming from /api/public/plans → trial_days (currently 30). Same fix as was applied to the Demo email templates.
(Optional) In demo-campaign history UI, distinguish sent_count=0 campaigns from successful ones.
critical_code_review_comments: hq_documents.py — good: subject/hero/CTA/pricing all take trial_days from get_trial_days() (subscriptions module). Founder path correctly overrides subject + skips attachments (from_name='Bablu Kumar · Miracurl').
routes/auth.py public_signup_salon — correctly awards trial_days=180 and signup_offer='founder_6m' when a matching founder demo_invite exists (verified end-to-end).
lead_gen.py wa-invite endpoints — GET recent/POST create/DELETE {id}/DELETE all all present; 404 correctly returned for unknown id.
Landing.jsx uses buildPlans() but the hero-pill trial text and CTA subtext appear hardcoded (7-day). These are the only remaining places where trial days do not follow the plan catalog.
